business_type_note: Real estate developer treated as 'Operating with a real-estate/NAV overlay' (not a pure REIT): Real Estate development ~80% of revenue, Leasing/Retail malls ~15%, Hospitality ~5%, plus a listed development subsidiary (Emaar Development PJSC) and a disclosed third-party NAV ~AED 247bn. Primary methods are EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCFF DCF, with NAV + SOTP as the real-estate/holding-company cross-checks. NOT a holding company on the Method Map. See 00_valuation-data-triage.md, 'Business-type note'.

scenarios.source: 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §3 (Bull/Base/Bear table — 'Implied Multiple' column); the denominators are the run's own: EPS AED 2.141 [02_multiples-own-history.md §1, P/E row] and BVPS AED 10.16 [02 §1 P/Book row; 01_price-and-capital-structure.md §6]. Every multiple here is IMPLIED: §3 derives the levels from a four-method blend (AED 16.52) less a disclosed AED 1.52 owner/peak-earnings wedge (RF-OWN-004) — see this case's `drivers` — not from a metric x multiple. P/E is this case's recorded primary because it is the reading that reproduces the level from a stated denominator; the normalized EV/EBITDA §3 emphasises has no stated normalized-EBITDA figure anywhere in the run, so it is a cross-check. The multiple is recorded at the precision that reproduces the level (21.0 / 2.141 = 9.8085); §3's own 1dp reading is 9.8x, which would move the frozen level by 0.0182. An implied multiple must never shift the level it was implied FROM.
scenarios.drivers: Asset value crystallises: masked wholly-owned Emaar Malls annuity re-rated + backlog delivered; DCF grid high / SOTP bull

discount_rate.wacc_note: 0.105 (10.5%) is the WACC actually USED in the base DCF, the sensitivity grid, and the reverse-DCF (04_intrinsic-dcf.md §3) — a disclosed +0.9pp override above the CAPM-computed 0.096 (9.60%), justified because the 8.5% debt weight understates the net-cash balance sheet and a single-city Dubai cycle warrants a premium. wacc_computed carries the pre-override CAPM/cost-of-debt blend for reference; all published fair values (methods.dcf=18.0, scenario levels) were generated with 0.105, not 0.096.
